_README: What `judge.py --self-test` asserts, per fixture. One entry per file in this
directory. `fires` names the checks this fixture is supposed to trip, and is what
the coverage assertion counts: a check named in CHECKS with no fixture listing it
under `fires` fails the self-test, because a check nobody has watched fail is not
evidence. `expect` is the exact result the scorer has to produce.

fixtures.why: The negative control. Correct group name, real figures, nothing planted. If any check fires here the check is too eager and every flag it has ever raised is suspect.
999,111 appears in no tool result and every result arrived whole, so there is no excerpt left to hide it in.
The same planted number with one result cut short. Proves the grey zone downgrades the verdict instead of asserting fabrication it cannot see.
Reaches GEO, but opens in PubMed. Presence-routing passes and first-call routing fails, which is the whole reason both are scored.
Never reaches the source that holds the answer.
Calls the federated tool that hands back an ENA HTTP 400 as ordinary tool text.
geo_search with no entry_type mixes GSE, GSM, GDS and GPL into one count.
Quotes 513, the unfiltered db=gds count, as the Series count. 37 is right.
Reports the federated page size as the ENA total. 551,679 runs exist for taxid 562.
organism="Escherichia coli" is not one of the 106 curated group names. Given a non-zero result on purpose, so this isolates the argument check from zero-as-absence.
The mirror image: right group name, a real zero, and an answer that publishes the zero as a finding. This is the shape argo/gpt4o shipped on 17 Sep.

The false positive argo/claudeopus5 q03 produced on 17 Sep. A zero from a secondary query, explained, next to the correct 37. zero_as_absence must NOT fire: the model resolved the zero instead of publishing it.
150,926 is the raw index row count for blaCTX-M-15; the service doubles E. coli and 75,487 distinct isolates carry it.

94,336 is mecA OR mecC. Attributed to mecA alone with no mention of mecC it is the wrong figure; mecA alone is 93,260. Everything else in this answer is correct, so the fixture also shows the trap firing without dragging the honest-null checks with it.
"I don't know" is the failure mode the honest-null check exists to catch: no decline marker, no reason, no source.
Says no, says nothing about why, names nowhere else. Separates the three parts of a refusal.
Declines with a real reason but leaves the user with nowhere to go.
The answer P8 asks for. All three parts present, so the null checks must all pass here or they are only measuring verbosity.
37 present and correct.

Routed right, fabricated nothing, tripped no trap, and still never gave the user the number. A judge without this check scores it clean. Nothing is put in its place, which is what separates it from ground-truth-substitute.
The other half of a miss: 19 stated where 37 is pinned. Under the >=100 fabrication floor, so no_fabrication is blind to it and every other check passes. This is argo/gpt4o q07, 17 Sep.
Argo returns HTTP 200 with ACCESS DENIED as assistant content. It has to be carried from the summary, not inferred, and it must not score as an answer.
A driver-level exception. Scored as its own outcome, never as a clean row.
Not denied, not an exception, and nothing said. The quietest way for a run to look fine and be worthless.
